slice_wrapper.go:13:18: unmarked struct field Value contains protected storage
  owner: rejected.Bad; field type: []rejected.Good
  rule: unmarked structs can store a Frozen record by value only when it has one named im.UncheckedValue field and no other data fields; they cannot store Local data
  fix: store Frozen pointers or handles; keep Local data in local bindings
slice_wrapper.go:13:24: unsupported immutable operation: native slices of immutable storage are unsupported
  source: []Good
  type: []rejected.Good
  fix: use im.FrozenSlice[T] and All() for iteration, or build a fresh local slice and consume it with im.FreezeSlice
